If you don't think the old monk's comments are far-fetched and corrupt, then you'll be very lucky! (An Quang Dharma Master Van Sao Tuc Bien, Upper volume, Letter to layperson Tu Giac)

(15) How cleverly, layman Banh Manh Am gave him the story of a filial girl in Hunan to read. That filial daughter only knows her mother, the virtuous daughter only knows righteousness, and doesn't care about her own life or death. Even though we have shown the example of burying ourselves for the sake of our mother and for the sake of righteousness, we cannot [use that example to] teach ordinary people; However, with sincerity and filial piety, even heaven and earth, ghosts and gods are moved, not to mention people with the same mind? Those who do not think about the blessings of upbringing and are free to fall in love, seeing and hearing these stories, are they not ashamed to die, so they painstakingly correct their mistakes first, and devote themselves to cultivating virtue later? This has a great bearing on the human world and human mind.

Furthermore, being as disciplined as Tan Chieu, at the same time keeping your heart from chaos is a hundred times more profound. Because it's easy to keep it for a while without chaos, but for many days without chaos is very difficult. What's more, Mr. Dang X... said: "If you can't control it, that girl will belong to you"? Furthermore, for dozens of days, a young man and a woman, eating together every day and sleeping together at night, can have no sex between men and women, and not disturb the natural principles, isn't that something that can be done without

humanity? I added this story to An Si Toan Thu and Tho Khang Bao Giam. Those two books have been printed more than twenty thousand copies, and now [the above story] is included in this book, forming a story of filial piety and decency to make a needle stab the top of the head of those who have abandoned morals, so that the disease that has penetrated into the viscera can be quickly healed, restoring the integrity of morality, fulfilling all duties, eliminating evil hearts, maintaining sincerity, not doing evil things, and observing good things. (An Quang Dharma Master Van Sao Tuc Bien, Lower volume, Preface to the Duong Tieu series Son Tien Sinh Ngon Hanh Luc)

Ten great benefits of reciting the Buddha's name

(Meaning that the person who recites the Buddha's name will definitely receive ten benefits
)

(1) Day and night, all the gods and great divine powers in hiding protect him or her.

(2) Often protected and blessed by twenty-five great Bodhisattvas such as Quan Am.

(3) Day and night, Buddhas often protect and chant, Amitābha Buddha often releases light to take care of that person.

(4) All evil spirits, yakshas, ​​and rakshasas cannot be harmed, nor can they be touched by poisonous snakes or poison.

(5) Water, fire, bandits, swordsmen, guns, shackles, prison... are not affected.

(6) All previous sins created are destroyed.

(7) At night, dreaming of a good omen, or seeing the wonderful golden body of Amitābha Buddha.

(8) The mind is always happy, the face is bright, the energy is full, and the work is good.

(9) Often respected and worshiped by everyone in the world, just like respecting Buddha.

(10) At the time of death, the mind is not afraid, mindfulness is present. The Western Three Saints used a golden platform to lead them to the Pure Land, to be reborn with lotus flowers, and to enjoy wonderful joy.

Please pay attention: Among these ten benefits, the previous nine are all benefits of transforming adversity and eliminating accidents. The ultimate benefit is that the next body escapes samsara.

Method of reciting Buddha's name

(1) The simplest morning and afternoon ceremony

Namo the great compassion of the Original Master Śākyamuni Buddha (reciting once, bowing once, or just clasping hands).

Namo the great compassion of Amitābha Buddha (reciting the same ceremony as above).

Namo Amitābha Buddha (no need to worship, just respectfully recite. Reciting on your knees, sitting, standing, all are fine. At least a hundred sentences to a thousand, ten thousand sentences depending on each person's free or busy work. Just increase from a little to a lot, don't decrease from a lot to a little).

Namo Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara) (one recitation, one prostration).

Namo Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva (reciting one thought, one bowing.

Avalokitesvara and That Chi are the two close attendants (Bodhisattva's close attendants) of Amitabha, often referred to collectively as the Western Three Saints. After reciting the Buddha's name, of course one should bow to them).

Namo Purity Dai Hai Bodhisattva (one thought, one bow. The world of Ultimate Bliss has many Bodhisattvas, all of whom will be our teachers and friends in the future, so we should also worship).

May this merit be used to adorn the Buddha's pure land. Up above, the temple has four great blessings. Below, to save suffering from three paths. If anyone sees or hears it, they will all develop the mind of Bodhisattva. This retribution is over. Together we will be born in the Pure Land. (This is a dedication song, also talking about your vow to recite the Buddha's name)

Retreat and worship.

Notes:

Every day, morning and afternoon, practice the above exercises two times. Wash your hands, rinse your mouth, burn incense in front of the Buddha statue, pay respects, and follow the correct chanting method. If there is no Buddha statue or the place where you live is not convenient, then it is okay not to burn incense or pay respects.

just facing the West with reverence in your heart also has the same merit. Don't recite the words in parentheses.

(2) Method of reciting the Buddha's name for ten breaths

Until one breath, recite a few sentences or six or seven sentences "namo Amitābha Buddha". After reciting ten breaths like that, recite the dedication all at once, bow and retreat.

Note:

This method is for extremely busy people, it only takes no more than five minutes. The most important thing is to practice once every day, morning and afternoon. There must be absolutely no interruption. If there is a Buddha statue, chant in front of the Buddha statue. If there is no Buddha statue, then do it facing the West.

The two ways of reciting Buddha's name mentioned above are for people who are too busy. If you have free time, after reciting "namo the great compassion of Amitābha Buddha", reciting a volume of the Amitabha Sutra, reciting the Rebirth mantra three times, and praising Buddha one time is even better. This practice is extremely simple, practical, and determines success.

tieu_de: Title of the book Tho Khang Bao Giam
noi_dung:
TITLE

Book title Tho Khang Bao Giam

There is no one who does not want to live a long life, be healthy, have peace, have many descendants, have a brilliant industry, and bring good fortune; No one wants to have a short life, premature death, illness, the extinction of descendants, the decline of the family, or the coming of evil spirits. That is the normal wish of people throughout the world. Even if the child is only three meters tall (Chinese meter), there is no one who does not [desire] like that. Even if you are a fool, you will not be happy at all because of disasters, you will be tired of blessings, and you will hate good things; But those who are lustful and lustful, the things their mind desires and the things they do with their body are actually contrary to each other. In the end, things you don't want happen, things you want cannot be achieved, isn't that sad? Let's not talk about those who indulge in flowers and willows, only longing for that; Even within husband and wife, if you continue to be greedy, you will certainly be destroyed and lose your life! There are also people who are not too greedy, but because they do not know how to abstain (the taboos are fully recorded in the back of the book, so here, I will not write clearly) they continue to recklessly pursue it, to the point of death. How pitiful!Therefore, the early sages who compiled the book Unable to Spell clearly understand the harmful effects of lust, [collected] aphorisms advising abstaining from lust, reducing lust, stories proving “blessings goodness, lewdness”1, methods of maintaining precepts, such as dates, times, places, people, things that should be taboo, without fear of trouble, are all presented in detail, so that readers know what to abstain from. What are you afraid of? That feeling of saving the people can be said to be "urgent, thorough, and earnest!" An Quang monk again attached2 that book, named it Tho Khang Bao Giam and donated the tomb to print it, in order to widely circulate it, because there was an unbearable heartache!

NOTE 1

Good blessings, lewd misfortune: Good people are blessed, lewd people suffer misfortune.

NOTE 2

Increase correction (增訂): Edit and correct misprints or omissions.

A disciple [of Quang] was La Te Dong, from Sichuan, forty-six years old, had a merchant ship in Shanghai, had a quite loyal personality, believed deeply in Buddhism, and together with a group of Mr. Quan Quynh Chi, etc., co-founded Tinh Nghiep Xa. During the 12th and 13th years of the Republic of China (1923-1924), he often wanted to go to [Pu Da] mountain to take refuge, but because he was busy with work, he could not fulfill his wish. In the 14th year of the Republic of China (1925), he suffered from ascites for several months. His situation was extremely dangerous. Chinese and Western medicine were ineffective. On August 14, when paying for the medicine, because the amount was too large, he got upset and said: "From now on, even if I die, I won't take medicine anymore." The wife then prayed earnestly to the Buddha, vowing to be a vegetarian all her life, chanting Buddha's name, and praying for her husband to be healed. At noon that day, the illness immediately changed, the bowels were full of water, and no medicine cured the illness.

At the end of August, Quang arrived in Than (Shanghai) and lived at Thai Binh pagoda. On the second day of the ninth month, we went to Tinh Nghiep Xa to meet with Mr. Quan Quynh Chi, and Mr. Te Dong was also present. Although the body is not completely healthy, the mood is pure and fresh, second to none. Meeting Quang, he happily said: "Master has come! I would like to take refuge in Than land, no need to go up the mountain anymore!" He chose the eighth day, went to Thai Binh pagoda with his wife, and observed the Three Refuges and Five Precepts. Again, we invited lay people Trinh Tuyet Lau, Quan Quynh Chi, Dinh Que Tieu, Au Duong Thach Chi, Tu Tri Lien, Nham Tam Bach, etc. to accompany Quang to dinner. On the 10th day, he invited Quang to his house for dinner, and said: "Master is the parents of the disciples, the disciples are the children of the master." Quang said: "Parents only worry when their children are sick. Now his illness is better, but he has not recovered yet, so you should be careful." Unfortunately, it is not clear that "the thing to be careful about" is about sex prevention. At the end of the month, at Cong Duc Lam, a Prison Enlightenment Festival was held, and he also attended the festival. After the meeting ended, a dozen people held Quang back to eat.He had just arrived, so he exchanged a few words with the bookkeeper and then left, his face looking exactly like a dead person. Quang knew it was because he had committed a crime in the office. I regret that at that time, I only said "parents only worry when their children are sick", without ever clearly stating the reason, which caused him to be in danger again.

I want to amend this book to urgently advise, but due to being busy, I haven't been able to do so. On the sixth day of the ninth month, Quang returned to the mountain and immediately sent a letter, explaining in detail the advantages and disadvantages, but there was no longer any medicine to save him, and a few days later [he] passed away. When he passed away, Mr. Quan Quynh Chi invited all lay people to come and recite Buddha's name. Whether Mr. La will be reborn in the West or not is unknown, but he will not fall to hell. Oh! After being seriously ill for several months, because of Tam Bao's illness, he was cured without using medicine. Within ten days, his mood was brighter than that of a normal person. Because he did not know how to be careful, he mistakenly committed a crime and died. Not only is she ruining her own life, but she also greatly betrays the grace of the Three Jewels! When Quang heard the news of the obituary, his heart ached, thinking that the world did not know how to abstain, he continued to recklessly pursue that matter, to the point of losing countless lives! If we do not establish a way to prevent and preserve it in advance, we will indeed lose the Tathagata's path of compassion and saving suffering. I intend to have Bat Khac Luc attached to the monks, printed and widely circulated, so that the whole world knows how to avoid it, so as not to make mistakes and lose one's life.

A lay person brought the money left by his mother, which was one thousand six hundred dong, and planned to print a charity book to give away. Quang told him to use all that money to print Tho Khang Bao Giam, to save young men and women who were not in danger. That is, due to the death of Mr. La Te Dong alone, it will cause all people to read books

this in the present and the future, everyone knows that they should be cautious and cautious, as well as by rotating circulation, advising each other in turn, will make the whole world enjoy long life, health, peace, the suffering of "obsession, fruit, loneliness, loneliness"3 becomes less and less common. Thus, because Mr. La Te Dong's death alone caused everyone to live long and healthy lives, Mr. Te Dong's death will have merit. Thanks to that merit, when dedicating it to rebirth, one will surely say goodbye to Sa Ba, ascend to the Pure Land, become a disciple of Amitābha Buddha, and be a good friend in the sea of ​​people. Mencius said: “Nurturing a false mind, good deeds result in desires” (There is nothing better in nurturing the mind than reducing desires). Although there are also people with few desires who have a short life, but they are very few. There are also people who have multiple desires and still live long lives, but [such people] are very few! When you are healthy, you should abstain from sex, not to mention when you are seriously ill to heal!

NOTE 3

Quan (鰥): Widowed, Qua (寡): Widowed, Aunt (孤): Orphan, Doc (獨): No children.

Ten years ago, the son of a great businessman, studying Western Medicine in Japan, parked first and sat on an electric car. Before the car stopped, he jumped down and broke his arm. Since he is a doctor, he should be treated immediately. Anyone with a bone injury must abstain from sex for one hundred or twenty days. His arm had not healed for long. To celebrate his mother's birthday, he immediately returned to the country, slept with his wife at night, and died the next day. This guy is quite smart, about to become a doctor, so why is he so stupid about this taboo, that a moment of pleasure takes away a very important life? How sad!

Last year, a businessman was having luck. The day before, he won a profit of six or seven hundred dong, quite pleased. The next day, from the concubine's place to the first wife's place, the wife was very happy. At that time, in May, the weather was very hot, so my wife turned on the electric fan, set up the bathtub, and took ice water mixed with honey to drink. I only know how to cool down, but I don't know: If you want to make love, you can't use cold substances. Less than three hours later, the stomach ache was dead! Therefore, we know: Because the world does not know how to abstain, it just keeps doing things haphazardly, to the point of countless deaths! But from ancient times until now, the person with the greatest blessing is no one more than the emperor. If the blessing is great, then the life span must also be long! Consider carefully: Of the ten kings, eight or nine of them did not live long; Isn't it because of too many lustful things and not knowing how to abstain, that we shorten our lifespan? The most intelligent people in the world often do not live long, because they do not understand this matter thoroughly! Quang often said: " Out of the ten parts of life, there are four parts that die due to lust . Although the four parts do not die directly because of lust, they still die because of greed for lust desire, and suffer all sorts of other indirect emotions.People inherently die because of fate, but only one or two out of ten!" The world is vast, with a large number of people, eight or nine out of ten people die because of lust, isn't that sad? That is the reason Quang circulates the book Tho Khang

Bao Giam. I hope that those who love their children in this world, as well as those who create happiness for their fellow countrymen and prevent calamities, will all develop the mind to send and circulate, so that everyone knows the taboos, so that they will not go astray, lose their lives, nor become disabled, to the point of not being able to achieve. Most of those who indulge in self-indulgence seek flowers and willows, mostly because they do not have the right view and are misled by licentious friends or erotic books, to the point of being trapped in a sea of ​​desires, unable to escape! If you read [this book] carefully, you will know the profound benefits and harms, regarding the things related to the glory or dishonor of ancestors and parents, as well as the "life, death, success, failure" of yourself and your family, as well as whether your descendants are good or foolish, extinct or prosperous, you will understand clearly like looking into a fire. If Heavenly Luong is not completely confused, is there anyone who, whenever they look at it, their heart will not be frightened, and their hearts will be pained and restrained? It will be seen that from then on, everyone will enjoy the heavenly wheel of husband and wife, not to the point of being greedy and harming themselves. They will grow old, have a long life, and be healthy. People with little desire often have many children.Their children are certainly physically strong, pure-minded, and not only do they not make the mistake of harming themselves, but they are also sure to become clever people who make their parents proud. That is exactly what Quang Thom Thao has longed for. I pray that readers will show their agreement, depending on the fate of the world, the people will be very lucky, and the country will also be very lucky!

NOTE 4

Qi mi (齊眉, eyebrow level): During the Later Han Dynasty, Luong Hong's wife, Manh Quang, when giving rice to her husband, raised the rice bowl as high as her eyebrows, implying respect for her husband as a distinguished guest. Later, the word "ti mi" was often used to express the idea that husband and wife respect each other. “Giai Lao” (偕老) means to live happily until your teeth are gray.

Late spring of the 16th year of the Republic of Korea (1927), i.e. the year of Dinh Mao and Thuong Tam Quy

Respectfully composed by Monk Thich An Quang

tieu_de: Preface to the reprint of the book Bat Khac Luc
noi_dung:
Preface to the reprint of the book The Impossible Book

The beauty of women is extremely fierce. From ancient times until now, due to this calamity, countries have been lost, families have been destroyed, families have lost their lives, families have lost their families, how can you tell! Even though it hasn't come to that yet, among them, those who are healthy become weak, their bright will becomes dark, their qualities turn from heaven to earth, hoping to "become saints, become sages", become ordinary, vile people, without the will to establish themselves, so is there a limit? What's more, those who go against the principles of heaven, violate human morality, live as animals wearing clothes and hats, and die and fall into the three evil paths, how can they see everything and know everything? Oh! This beautiful woman is so fierce! Therefore, the saints and sages, especially with compassion, either use hard words to admonish, or use gentle words to advise, so that throughout the world everyone will know the principle of “good blessings, misfortunes sexuality.” They also point out the truths to admonish, so that those who know how to love themselves, when they read it, will be afraid, frightened, understand, dry up the flood of humanity, and restore the coming heaven. destroyed. From then on, all people of the same origin enjoy the blessings of "longevity, health, peace", and are forever free from the dangers of "poverty, illness, and premature death".This is the reason for compiling the volume The Impossible Volume. Layperson Truong Thuy Tang wanted to engrave it and print it for alms, so he asked me to write a preface to show the important meaning of reducing desire.

Need to know: In the face of beauty, the lustful mind is burning, it is difficult for the words of advice about cause and effect to be hard or soft to cut off the craving. If [at that time] one can meditate on impurity, a fire of desire will immediately disappear. My children from Chang'an in Qin (Shaanxi) mostly like to play cricket. There were three teenage brothers who went out on a moonlit night to catch crickets at a graveyard. They suddenly saw a beautiful young woman and chased after them. The young woman's face changed, her eyes were bleeding, her tongue stuck out more than a meter long, the three children were scared to death. The next day, the family found and saved one child and found out about it. The surviving child had a serious illness that took several months to recover. His children and grandchildren did not dare to go catch crickets at night anymore! When that young woman had not changed her face, her love entered her bones, her desire could not be satisfied! When his face changed, he was scared to death, his love was no longer there! But while they were chasing her together, of course there was no blood or tongues sticking out. Why, when the blood has not yet flowed and the tongue is still closed, does love arise? When the blood flows and the tongue sticks out, does it give rise to fear?Understanding this clearly, every time I see the colors and scents of heaven, I think like a hanging devil, with seven senses bleeding out, my tongue sticking out more than a meter, how can I be so bewitched by the colors, I can't live to enjoy the rest of my life, and when I die, I'll fall into the evil path forever?

NOTE 5

The two eyes, two ears, two nostrils and mouth are collectively called the seven senses (七竅).

Therefore, the Tathagata teaches those with heavy desires to contemplate impurity. If you meditate for a long time, you can also cut off Or, realize the Truth, and become a saint; Is it just not committing adultery, abstaining from sex, and preserving life? A woman with beautiful and graceful beauty, making others fall in love and engage in sexual activities, is nothing more than a thin layer of skin on the outside, brilliant and bewitching beauty! If you peel off that thin layer of skin, not only will the objects wrapped in that layer of skin be incapable of love, but even that thin layer of skin will absolutely be incapable of love! If you still dissect the body, you will only see blood and pus, bones and flesh tangled, internal organs, feces, and small pieces all over the ground, dirty and fishy, ​​you can't bear to see it! Compared to the transformed appearance of the young woman above, it is a hundred times, a thousand times more terrifying and disgusting!

Even if a peerless beauty is overwhelmed by water, who wouldn't be like that when it comes to things contained within a thin layer of skin? Why do people only look at the outside appearance and not carefully consider the content? Love a little bit of beauty, don't care about a lot of ugliness? I hope that people will let go of the external appearance, look at the content, be tired of the "many evils", put aside a little bit of [external] beauty, in order to escape the sea of ​​desires and reach the shore of enlightenment. In times of burning lust that cannot be controlled, one should only think of the female voice as the mouth of a poisonous snake, as if putting one's own male organ into the snake's mouth, one's mind panics, one's bones tremble. The boundless heat of the brain will cool down in an instant! That is the simplest method to eliminate lust!

NOTE 6

Female yin (女陰): A woman's genitals.

Compiled by Thich An Quang.

tieu_de: The preface [advises] to maintain the moral integrity of the book Bat Khac Luc
noi_dung:
Foreword [advice] to keep the morality intact for the book Bat Luc Luc

Heaven is the great father, earth is the great mother. All men and women are children of heaven and earth, they are my blood relatives. Since we are blood relatives, we must wholeheartedly harmonize, love, protect, support, and hope for everyone to be at peace. In this way, we will be a worthy child of heaven and earth, not bringing shame to the one who gave birth to us! If one can protect and support the children of heaven and earth, surely heaven and earth will always protect and support that person, making their blessings deep, their life long, and everything as they wish. If you let emotions prevail and oppress the children of heaven and earth, you will lose your blessings, shorten your life, destroy your family, and become extinct. When you breathe out and cannot breathe in again, you will forever fall into an evil path for hundreds of thousands of lifetimes and will never be able to be a human again! That is self-inflicted disaster. Is it true that heaven and earth are not merciful?

Let's not talk about other things, like wives, children, sisters, brothers, everyone has them. If someone looks at our own wife, children, or sisters, we immediately become angry, angry, and want to fight. Why, when we see that someone else's wife, children, or sisters have some beauty, our mind begins to think lustfully, intending to humiliate them? Together we are children of heaven and earth, our flesh and blood. If you give rise to unrighteous thoughts towards your blood relatives, it will be a disgrace to the children of heaven and earth, contempt for your blood relatives, can that person still stand in heaven and earth, is he still worthy of being called a human being? What's more, the morality of husband and wife belongs to the Three Cuongs and Five Thuongs, and getting married for men and women is a great precept for humans. The reason humans are different from animals is because they have humanity. If you do something that disrespects reason and commits incest, you are using your human body to do something animalistic; Although the body is human, in reality, it is not as good as an animal. Why is that? Because animals do not know morality, humans know morality! Knowing morality but still disdaining morality, must be below animals!

But all sentient beings are born from lust, so that habit is especially heavy and must be deeply prevented. Perceiving as a loved one, perceiving as a resentful person, perceiving as impure, in order to put an end to evil thoughts, is purely mindfulness. Resentment and impurity were mentioned in the previous preface, here, we only promote the idea of ​​“thinking like a person body”, so that readers can keep the whole wheel of heaven and not hold evil thoughts. The Sutra Forty-Two Chapters teaches people to view women as follows: “Think of the elderly as a mother, the older as an older sister, the younger as a younger sister, consider the little child as a daughter, one can liberate the mind, cut off evil thoughts.” The Brahma Vong Sutra teaches: “All men are my father, all women are my mother. Forever and ever. No matter how we are not born from them, we must give birth to a heart of filial piety and a heart of compassion.

During the Ming Dynasty, there was a student who had a lustful habit and could not control himself, so he asked Vuong Long Khe7. Long Khe said: "Suppose someone told you: 'There is a famous prostitute here, you can come and have fun'. Following that, you went to meet her, and it turned out to be your mother, or sister. At that moment, would your lust have cooled?" Answer: “Cool!” Long Khe said: "But lust is inherently empty, please understand properly." If people are willing to consider all women as mothers, daughters, sisters, and brothers, not only will evil and lustful thoughts arise from nowhere, but thanks to that they will also quickly escape the cycle of birth and death! In the Book of the Impossible Book, strong or gentle admonitions, stories of blessings due to kindness, misfortunes due to sexual immorality, and days and places where one should abstain from sexual intercourse, are all clearly stated. It can be said that the mind of "enlightening the unconscious world" was both sincere and earnest.

NOTE 7

Long Khe is the name of Vuong Ky (1498-1583), self-styled Nhu Trung, a thinker who promoted the theory of Three Religions Concurring in the Ming Dynasty. Mr. Vuong strongly supports Vuong Duong Minh's doctrine of "unified practice". His works were compiled into the Complete Collection of Long Khe Tien Sinh.

Layman Truong Thuy Tang in Duy Duong, interested in the interests of people, immediately had it printed and circulated, ordering Quang to clearly expose important things, in order to suppress lust. Therefore, I describe the general meaning of “perception as a resentful person, perception as impure pure”. Next, because his cousin Chanh Huan had passed away, he wanted to use this merit to pursue his spiritual consciousness, so that his sin obstacles could be destroyed, his blessings would be high, he could escape the five impurities of the Desire Realm, and be born in the nine federal levels. Because of the filial piety of the lay people, I wrote a preface discussing the matter of keeping morality intact. I hope that those who see and hear it will consider it thoroughly. They will be very lucky!

Compiled by Thuong An Quang respectfully

tieu_de: Preface to promote adoption and circulation of the book Duc Hai Hoi Cuong
noi_dung:
Foreword to encourage the adoption and circulation of the book Duc Hai Hoi Cuong

The disaster is extremely dire, extremely great, extremely deep in the world, if it is suddenly touched, it is certain to be buried, to lose one's life, but many people still like to pursue it, to throw themselves into it, even if they die, they will not regret it, perhaps only women that's it! Lustful men indulge in sexual pursuits, pick flowers, break willows, steal jade, steal incense, kill the truth, commit incest, lose their family, humiliate their ancestors, spreading evil rumors throughout the village, leaving a bad reputation for their children and grandchildren, not being able to enjoy the full lifespan of their lives, and when they die, they will fall forever in the evil path. Let's not talk about those guys! Even in the love between husband and wife, those who are so immersed in it that they lose their lives, how can you tell? Originally looking for pleasure, suddenly died! The suffering of widowhood is indeed largely self-inflicted! Is it entirely due to fate's fate? Those who are attached to mats and blankets are bringing disaster upon themselves. There are also people who are not at all reckless or infatuated, but because they do not know how to abstain, they continue to do reckless things, leading to many deaths!Therefore, the Thien Nguyet Order in the Book of Rites has a passage about the main command: “Be sure to announce the announcement, the spirit world Dung chi” (King the wooden bell commands to abstain from sexual intercourse) (“Dung chi” (容止) means movement, that is, lovemaking). The compassion for the people of the ancient saintly kings can be said to "not miss any small thing" (the taboo places are clearly written in Tho Khang Bao Giam, so you should read carefully).

I often say: Out of ten out of ten people in the world, about four out of ten people die directly because of lust, and four out of those die indirectly, that is, due to being consumed by lust and suffering from other emotions. No one blames fate for those who died. Who knows that death due to greed for lust is not due to fate. If one is to [die for the sake of] one's life, one must keep a pure heart, be chaste, and not be greedy for lustful things! Those greedy people are all ruining their lives. looked at the last page, knew it was Mr. Van Cuu Sa's copy, was very happy, bought it, and immediately printed out three thousand copies. NOTE 169

Phlegmon is a disease of epilepsy and convulsions. Because the patient has a lot of phlegm and often convulses, it is called phlegmon.

NOTE 170

Hoa Phan Sat (花粉煞) is a term in Taoism. Feng Shui experts believe that if a room has carved pillars, too much painting, or is too cumbersome, the person living in it will suffer from bad luck and strange illnesses.

To engrave and print books, in ancient times, khanh han 171 was used, later it changed to using do tree wood [to make paper] and ink. It was transformed into engraved boards, making [printing] quite convenient, and writing was circulated more widely. The method of engraving a board is to first use paper to write down [the text you want to print], paste it on the wooden board, then rub the back of the paper, causing the words to stick to the board [then the worker will engrave the words according to those words]. The paper that has been rubbed off still has the shape of writing, so don't let it get dirty or dirty.

NOTE 171

Hanjian (汗簡) are fresh bamboo sticks, heated over fire to melt the sap, then carved with a knife. Before paper was invented, ancient people used this method to record history books.

In the fall of the year At Suu (1805) in the reign of Gia Khanh, at Bao Huu Bridge in Hang Chau city, there was a carver surnamed Kim.
